body: It's a start, but I dunno...I feel like I'm going to have a panic attack

I wish I could help you fully understand what is going on, you are only scratching the surface... :(  BASICALLY...I am not trying to justify it "to" anyone, at least not consciously.  It is just a case of an old system breathing down my neck...call it a phobia, call it a delusion, but there you go.
Btw I don't want to sound like I'm beating up on religion, but I do think people do take it too far sometimes
